verdict: Paid campaigns have been paused 12 days; leads have stopped completely.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns went dark on August 6 and have not run since, bringing paid leads to zero for the past 12 days. All 45 leads this period — at $26.04 per lead — came from the active weeks before that pause. Organic channels are holding at a reduced level, and website sessions were up notably mid-week, suggesting some residual brand awareness in the market. Ads are being reactivated this week to restore lead flow. Once campaigns are back on, you should see leads resume at a pace consistent with the earlier part of this period.
